description: Lists upcoming Siena friendship dinners in a city between two dates, and says which ones are open to book. Siena holds one dinner a week, on Thursday at 7:30pm London time, for small groups of strangers who want to make friends. A few holiday Thursdays have no dinner, and the list leaves them out. Booking for a Thursday opens on the Wednesday two weeks before and closes on the Tuesday before at 23:59. With no dates, the tool lists the next 4 Thursdays. It lists up to 12 weeks ahead.

city.description: City name or id. Only "London" has dinners. Defaults to London.

from.description: First date to include, yyyy-mm-dd, London time. Defaults to today.

to.description: Last date to include, yyyy-mm-dd, London time. Defaults to 4 weeks after from.

name: list_upcoming_dinners

booking_status.description: open: a seat can be booked now. not_open_yet: booking opens on the Wednesday two weeks before. closed: booking closed on the Tuesday before.

starts_at.description: ISO 8601 with the London UTC offset.

every_dinner.description: Facts that are the same for every dinner.

amount.description: Seat price in the currency's main unit.

title: List upcoming Siena dinners
